statement: Under the stated box domains and uniform (M_f,T_f,Delta_f) piecewise-polynomial training objective, Pdim(L)=O(p*d*log(M_f+T_f+d)+p^2*d*log(Delta_f)).
quantifiers: For every instance class satisfying the uniform structural and nonempty-minimizer assumptions.
proof_route: Encode ell>=t with one universal d-dimensional block, count M_f+T_f+2d atoms, and specialize C1.
